title: Specmetry error envelope v1
description: Returned by the CLI (--json) and HTTP API on failure. CLI exit codes: invalid_input=2, not_found=2, human_required=3, not_initialized=4, stale_precondition=5, environment=6, internal=1 (unauthorized/forbidden are HTTP-only). HTTP status: invalid_input=400, unauthorized=401, forbidden=403, human_required=403, not_found=404, not_initialized=404, stale_precondition=409, environment=503, internal=500.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the submitted document.

current.description: For stale_precondition: the current values the caller must re-read (e.g. base_version, revisions, snapshot, evidence_id).
